Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- card_ext_refund_credit compute takes `refund_date` and `delay_credit_date`/`cancel_credit_date` with an unwindowed XLATEST, while the rule text says "the latest of those refund dates" / "of those delay-credit dates" (the 3-month set). Whenever an in-window row exists (which the clock rules and a non-zero uncredited refund require), the unwindowed latest equals the in-window latest, so the two readings coincide; no effect on the KB or this task. Noted for completeness only.
- frozen_time 2026-10-12 is a federal holiday (Columbus Day); nothing scored depends on a business-day credit date in this task.
